title: PDRN Brightening Serum Ingredients | Tava Labs
description: Every ingredient in the PDRN Brightening Serum explained, from PDRN and peptides to sodium hyaluronate and panthenol, plus the full INCI list and what we leave out.
contentHtml:
Ingredients

The formula behind a polished appearance.

Quality ingredients, combined with care, for founders who need to look composed and prepared on camera and on calls and in the room.

Your appearance is part of your professional presence, and the formula has one job. Help you show up looking sharp and rested and ready, even after long days building the business. The PDRN Brightening Serum pairs PDRN with peptides and proven conditioning ingredients in a lightweight formula that absorbs quickly with no greasy residue. Here is what is in it, what each key ingredient does for the look of your skin, and what we leave out.

Key Ingredients

PDRN (Polydeoxyribonucleotide)

PDRN, also called Polydeoxyribonucleotide. The headline active in the formula. PDRN supports a smooth and luminous looking complexion, so your face reads fresh and rested in person and on camera.

Acetyl Hexapeptide-8

A peptide that works alongside PDRN to support smoother looking skin. It helps soften the look of fine lines, so your face looks relaxed and polished in close conversations and in high definition video.

Sodium Hyaluronate (Hyaluronic Acid)

Sodium Hyaluronate, also called Hyaluronic Acid. A powerful humectant that draws in moisture and helps skin look plump and soft. A supporting fact for the main promise, skin that looks rested even when the schedule says otherwise.

Panthenol

Panthenol, also known as pro vitamin B5. Panthenol conditions the skin for a silky and comfortable feel and supports a calm and healthy looking finish.

Glycerin + Sodium PCA

A moisture duo that helps skin hold onto water and feel smooth to the touch. Together they give the serum its silky texture and comfortable wear with no greasy feeling.

Full Ingredients

Aqua (Water), Glycerin, Propanediol, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Sodium PCA, Polydeoxyribonucleotide, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium Hydroxide

PDRN Brightening Serum · 1 fl oz (30 ml) · Made in the USA · Suitable for all skin types.

What We Leave Out

What we leave out matters as much as what we put in. The PDRN Brightening Serum is made without the following:

Cruelty Free

Never tested on animals.

Fragrance Free

No added perfumes or synthetic scents.

Mineral Oil Free

No mineral oil or petroleum-based fillers.

Phthalate Free

No phthalates in the formula.

Silicone Free

No silicones coating your skin.

Sulfate Free

No harsh sulfates — gentle on skin.

Allergen Free

Made without common allergens.

Alcohol Free

No drying alcohols.

How to Use

Apply 2 to 4 pumps to clean and dry skin. Massage over face and neck until absorbed. Use twice daily, morning and night, as your preparation step before the working day and as your closing step at night. Follow with moisturizer or sunscreen in the morning.

Warning

For external use only. Avoid eyes. Discontinue if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children. Do not use on broken skin. Store in a cool, dry place.
